    # Control gains for stability (adjusted to balance pole balance and cart position)

    force = -300.0 * theta - 75.0 * omega - 60.0 * (x - target_x) - 20.0 * v
    
    # Add boundary correction term
    force += boundary_term
    
    # Clamp force within actuator limits
    lim = CART_FORCE_LIMIT_NEWTONS
    sandbox.apply_cart_force(max(-lim, min(lim, force)))
